description: Stable case catalog for the public-safe messy .NET workspace regression slice. Cases are marked implemented or deferred; this catalog is an inventory and does not claim deferred cases are proven. Implemented cases are pinned by src/dotnet/tests/TraceMap.Tests/MessyWorkspaceRegressionTests.cs.

artifactPinning.determinismContract: repeat CLI scans of each root produce byte-identical facts.ndjson
artifactPinning.generatorAndInputHashes: no new derived machine-readable artifact is introduced by this slice; provenance stays in the existing scan manifest (scanner version, commit SHA) and rule-catalog extractor versions
artifactPinning.failureIdentification: every test assertion names the catalog case id and the pipeline stage: extraction, combining, reconciliation, or traversal

cases.shape: handler chain of twelve call edges across Pages/, Services/, and Data/ folders ending in an ADO.NET-style supported SQL terminal at graph distance 14, beyond depths 8, 10, and 12
cases.assertions: at max depth 12 the terminal inventory is complete with identical boundary identity sets at depths 12 and 16 and minimum terminal distance 14; path enumeration honestly truncates with the depth reason while the terminal stays inventoried (no false absence); at depth 10 the distance-14 terminal falls outside the depth-bounded retained closure and the observation must scope its completeness claim to the retained graph instead of implying or inventing a terminal

cases.shape: three-node call cycle (First -> Second -> Third -> First) entered from a page handler
cases.assertions: traversal terminates on the cycle branch, records cycle truncation honestly, and reports the branch as downstream-without-supported-terminal rather than inventing a terminal

cases.shape: self-recursive method (Self calls Self) entered from its own dedicated page handler
cases.assertions: the self-cycle handler's own chain is selected independently of the three-node cycle: traversal terminates, records cycle truncation, inventories zero terminals, and surfaces its own scoped downstream-without-terminal gap

cases.shape: the same method names Process and Core in ten classes in one file, each ending in a distinct SQL terminal
cases.assertions: ten container-distinct identities survive extraction; traversal inventories ten distinct terminal witnesses; no call edge joins one engine's Process or Core to another engine's container

cases.shape: three independently scanned roots combined into one merged review with explicit labels
cases.assertions: combined sources, facts, and symbols are the union of the inputs with per-source namespacing and no symbol deduplication; root-beta reuses the Process/Core simple names from root-alpha and all twelve identities stay distinct rows; every DatabaseOperationCandidate terminal stays attributed to its own source label (11 alpha, 1 beta, 1 vb) with its own table identity; the merged dependency report lists all three labeled sources; the Web Forms packet stays single-page-source by design, so cross-source attribution is asserted over the merged index directly

cases.shape: loose VB files with no .vbproj or .sln, including an App_Code folder, scanned through the portable Roslyn syntax fallback
cases.assertions: analysis level is Level3SyntaxAnalysis; the fail-closed workspace gap is present at Tier4; the data-adapter fill produces a Tier3 database operation attached to the handler; no blocker exists for projectless VB in ordinary CI

cases.shape: source spread across nested folders (Pages/, Services/, Data/, App_Code/) inside one root and across independently scanned roots
cases.assertions: call edges span folders with folder-relative file paths and the deep chain crosses the Services/ to Data/ boundary

cases.shape: same-name overloads with distinct signatures invoked ambiguously during traversal
cases.blocker: identity retention for overloads is already pinned by compiled-lane CS-OVERLOAD-001 and VB-OVERLOAD-001; a traversal-level overload ambiguity fixture is the next fixture slice, not this PR

cases.shape: bare or dynamic receivers that could bind to any of several same-name members during traversal
cases.blocker: receiver forms are partially covered by the C# identity receiver fixture tests and the projectless VB receiver fail-closed gaps; a dedicated ambiguous-receiver traversal fixture is the next fixture slice

cases.shape: call chains crossing C#/VB/F# language boundaries in one merged review
cases.blocker: no F# source adapter exists; cross-language identity joins require the compiled-lane source-to-metadata reconciliation, which is separate from this slice

cases.shape: compiler-generated and designer-generated members participating in traversal
cases.blocker: generated-member identity labeling is pinned by compiled-lane CS-GENERATED-005; the messy-workspace traversal variant is deferred to a later slice

cases.shape: source to metadata to IL/PDB identity chain over messy workspace roots
cases.blocker: owned by the remaining #766 ILAsm/rewritten-PDB public rewrite-suite matrix under the open Task 10 checkbox; explicitly not this integration slice
